title: Requests for a higher role or an Admin-only screen

sections.heading: A user asks for administrator rights or an Admin-only screen
sections.text: Some screens, such as the access audit screen, are available only to the Admin role. Tier 1 staff do not change roles, give administrator rights, or open Admin-only screens for another user. They record the request and route it to an authorized administrator.

steps.text: Record the role or screen the user asks for and the reason the user gives.
An authorized administrator reviews the request and decides whether any role change is appropriate.

information_needed.prompt: The role or screen the user asks for.

stop_conditions.text: If the user asks to see another team's or site's records, stop and escalate to the Support Lead.
